mixless beta.3 improves AutoMix, library preparation and the native interface, with a refreshed bilingual website and direct release downloads.

## Changes since beta.2

- Improve tempo, phrase, build-up and drop analysis. Preserve complete musical peaks and manual cue boundaries; use measured recovery passages for earlier handoffs where safe, carrying the actual playback tempo into the next pair.
- Add spinback and loop-out transitions, optional live filter/stem moves, and overlap gain compensation. Manual controls retain priority.
- Add queued recursive folder imports, per-playlist track ordering, missing-file recovery and expanded MIDI controls.
- Add independent deck/master limiter gains and fix recording finalization, acquisition cleanup and library compatibility backups.
- Harden signed self-updates with channel/version checks, verified staging and atomic bundle replacement. Manual checks preserve the restart notice after an update is installed.
- Unify lowercase mixless branding, refine About with copyable build details and keyboard navigation, and refresh the website/README with real Retina screenshots and rounded icons.
- Provide English and Chinese guides, local search, restrained landing animations, and automatic stable downloads with beta fallback and alternate download options.

## Install or update

Download **Mixless-macOS-0.1.0-beta.3.dmg** below. The universal app supports Apple Silicon and Intel Macs running macOS 12 or later. The app and DMG are Developer ID signed, Apple notarized and stapled. Open the DMG and drag mixless to Applications, or double-click the app to install.

Existing beta users can choose **mixless → Check for Updates…**, then restart when prompted. `SHA256SUMS.txt` verifies the installer; `mixless-beta-latest.json` is the in-app updater feed. These filenames remain compatible with earlier releases.

[Website and downloads](https://mixless.alkinum.com/#downloads) · [User guide](https://mixless.alkinum.com/docs) · [中文指南](https://mixless.alkinum.com/docs/zh)

## Beta limitations

Analysis and AutoMix choices remain estimates; audition unfamiliar transitions. The real-time stress suite still has unresolved catalogue, dual-deck and retriggered-cue timing failures documented in the development history. Functional tests and offline renders do not establish glitch-free playback under every workload. Spotify supplies playlist metadata; playable audio must be available locally.
